title: Opt-In Connection Check on Client Build
mini_srs: This milestone adds an opt-in connection check to the Rust Qdrant client build() method. gRPC connections are established lazily so building a client succeeds even when the server is unreachable and connection errors only surface on the first API call. The new check_connection config flag with a check_connection() builder method and set_check_connection() setter makes build() perform a health check and return an error eagerly instead of deferring it. Default behavior is unchanged to preserve backward compatibility. Server-free unit tests verify both the lazy default and eager opt-in build paths.
expansion_rationale: Standalone feature commit (L0 D0) touching config.rs and mod.rs in rust-client. Patch analysis confirms self-contained scope: adds check_connection bool to QdrantConfig struct (config.rs lines 42-47) with builder method (lines 219-236) and setter (lines 241-248). The build path in mod.rs (lines 106-181) is restructured to surface health-check errors eagerly when the flag is set. Two unit tests (mod.rs lines 270-288) cover the lazy and eager paths without a running server. No DAG edges exist (0 descendants 0 ancestors). PR #286.

title: Remove Deprecated Fastembed add and query Methods
mini_srs: This milestone removes the previously deprecated add() query() and query_batch() methods along with their supporting infrastructure from both the sync and async fastembed mixins. The removed methods include set_model set_sparse_model embedding_model_name and sparse_embedding_model_name properties get_vector_field_name get_sparse_vector_field_name get_fastembed_vector_params get_fastembed_sparse_vector_params and internal helpers _embed_documents _sparse_embed_documents _points_iterator _validate_collection_info and _scored_points_to_query_responses. This forces migration to the standard upsert/search/query_points API with models.Document and models.Image inference wrappers. Net deletion of approximately 1322 lines across qdrant_fastembed.py and async_qdrant_fastembed.py. The get_embedding_size signature changes from optional to required model_name parameter.

title: Payload Path Handling and JSON-Path Utilities for Local Mode
mini_srs: This milestone introduces and extends the local mode payload path handling subsystem to match server semantics for all json-path operations. The seed (f7530a2) fixes delete_payload to honor nested json-path keys by adding delete_value_by_key alongside the existing set_value_by_key and tightens json_path_parser.py to reject negative indices and non-ASCII digits. Subsequent commits isolate payload values across wildcard targets so that a scoped set_payload on one array element does not reach others (e0dcd93) and add null-key removal in payload merging via merge_payload to match the server merge_map behavior (4f9f8bb). The payload selector rewrite (c10adff) replaces string prefix matching with a parsed selector tree in payload_value_extractor.py using parse_json_path for include and exclude operations with quoted-key support. Array flattening for terminal [] and [i] paths (3b00b3f) and its group_by consumer (6d287c3) complete the value extraction parity. Together these bring json_path_parser.py payload_value_setter.py and payload_value_extractor.py into full server congruence.
expansion_rationale: Six commits unified by the payload path handling theme across json_path_parser.py payload_value_setter.py and payload_value_extractor.py. Seed f7530a2 (PR #1407) adds delete_value_by_key in payload_value_setter.py (lines 119-170) and tightens index parsing in json_path_parser.py (lines 143-157). DAG edge f7530a2->4f9f8bb via payload_value_setter.py and local_collection.py. e0dcd93 (PR #1438) fixes deepcopy isolation in WildcardIndexSetter (payload_value_setter.py lines 280-297). DAG edge e0dcd93->4f9f8bb via payload_value_setter.py. 4f9f8bb (PR #1530) adds merge_payload (payload_value_setter.py lines 88-96) used in KeySetter IndexSetter WildcardIndexSetter. c10adff (PR #1483) adds include_payload/exclude_payload in payload_value_extractor.py (lines 84-159) using _selector_tree with lru_cache. DAG edge 4f9f8bb->c10adff via local_collection.py. 3b00b3f (PR #1474) rewrites _get_value in payload_value_extractor.py (lines 33-48) to flatten at the base case. DAG edge 6d287c3->3b00b3f via local_collection.py. 6d287c3 (PR #1523) removes the manual unwrap in _group_by_values using the fixed value_by_key.

title: Isolate Sparse Vectors at Storage Boundaries
mini_srs: This milestone ensures sparse vectors in local mode are properly isolated at storage boundaries to prevent cross-contamination between named sparse vector spaces. The seed (d6f79fd) introduces copy_sparse_vector in sparse.py and inserts it at every point where a SparseVector crosses the API boundary in local_collection.py: get_vectors_by_id (line 555) _vector_by_point_id (line 1860) update paths (lines 2558-2643) and _validate_point which is refactored to return a normalized copy instead of mutating the caller s point (lines 2696-2731). A comprehensive test_vector_isolation.py (201 lines) parametrically covers all write paths (insert replacing_upsert batch update_vectors batch_update_points) and read paths (retrieve scroll query). The follow-on commit (d5ef5cc) corrects IDF statistics by introducing _drop_idf_contribution and _existing_idx helpers so that the sparse IDF corpus stays accurate when points or vectors are deleted and when update_vectors encounters missing points.
expansion_rationale: Two commits forming the sparse vector isolation mini-feature. Seed d6f79fd (PR #1424) adds copy_sparse_vector to sparse.py (lines 14-20) using pydantic construct with list copies rather than deepcopy. In local_collection.py it replaces 4 direct references with copy calls and refactors _validate_point to return a new PointStruct (lines 2691-2731). DAG edge d6f79fd->d5ef5cc via local_collection.py. d5ef5cc (PR #1427) adds _drop_idf_contribution (lines 233-244) which checks deleted/deleted_per_vector before removing IDF counts and _existing_idx (lines 246-255) returning None for deleted points. It rewrites delete_vectors (lines 2949-2965) update_vectors (lines 2867-2932) set_payload overwrite_payload delete_payload and clear_payload to skip deleted points and raise KeyError for missing ones. Boundary note: 13ce595 (sparse uint32 validation) is excluded as it is sparse VALIDATION belonging to G08 via seed 1860632.

title: gRPC Payload Conversion Performance Optimization
mini_srs: This milestone optimizes the gRPC payload conversion pipeline in conversion.py for significantly faster serialization and deserialization. The seed (789eced) rebuilds json_to_value with exact type checks and a new _json_to_value_kwargs helper that returns argument dicts instead of Value objects so protobuf builds the entire nested tree in one constructor call. A compatibility shim handles protobuf versions below 6.30 that do not accept dict map values. Follow-on commits fix encoding of non-JSON payload types such as uuid and datetime through pydantic to_jsonable_python under both pydantic v1 and v2 (cbb9d43) replace MessageToDict-based response parsing with direct WhichOneof field reads and add numpy array fast-path uploads via raw bytes with protobuf framing (70e3d30) refactor payload_to_grpc to use the argument-dict strategy for map fields on protobuf at least 6.30 (7a55e3a) and fix truthiness checks on batch payload and vector point lists to prevent empty-list drops (82728a5).
expansion_rationale: Five commits forming a complete gRPC conversion optimization chain in conversion.py. Seed 789eced (PR #1513) introduces _json_to_value_kwargs (conversion.py lines 49-94) and caches _NULL_VALUE. DAG edges: 789eced->cbb9d43 789eced->70e3d30 789eced->7a55e3a all via conversion.py modify_overlap. cbb9d43 (PR #1473) fixes _pydantic_compat.py to use pydantic_encoder for v1 and widens the exception handler from KeyError to TypeError (conversion.py line 88). 70e3d30 (PR #1514) rewrites value_to_json with WhichOneof (conversion.py lines 84-111) removes has_field helper adds numpy raw-byte upload in grpc_uploader.py (lines 22-75 _dense_vector_prefix _set_numpy_vector convert_vector_struct). 7a55e3a (PR #1562) adds _VALUE_FIELDS lookup table (conversion.py lines 43-48) and _payload_to_value_kwargs (lines 113-126) with version-gated assignment. DAG edge 7a55e3a->82728a5. 82728a5 (PR #1572) fixes is-not-None checks replacing truthiness checks on SetPayloadOperation OverwritePayloadOperation DeletePayloadOperation and DeleteVectorsOperation point lists (conversion.py lines 4891-4990).
